description: Land Acquisition - Weragalawatta, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2114/80 of 12.03.2019
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions (paddy field, garden, tank, road), claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
